data.current_summary: Upload an asset to the media library from a URL
data.current_description:
Fetches a public or preauthorized HTTPS URL through Sanity's bounded egress proxy, then processes the response with the ordinary Media Library upload pipeline. The source is limited to 50 MiB and the fetch may take up to 300 seconds. Caller credentials and headers are not forwarded to the source. Provide `filename` in the JSON request body; the `filename` query parameter used by `/upload` is not accepted here.

Follows up to three redirects. The source and each redirect destination must use HTTPS without embedded credentials and pass the source policy. The JSON request body is limited to 1 MiB plus 4 KiB, including aspects.

The request stays open while the asset is fetched and uploaded. Allow more than 300 seconds for the client request. Media processing can continue after the response. If the connection closes or the request times out, check the library before retrying: an asset or version may already have been created.
data.summary_suggestion: Fetch and upload asset from HTTPS URL to media library
data.description_suggestion: Fetches an asset from a public or preauthorized HTTPS URL via Sanity's bounded egress proxy and uploads it to the media library. Source size limit: 50 MiB; fetch timeout: 300 seconds. Supports up to 3 redirects; all destinations must use HTTPS without embedded credentials. Caller credentials are not forwarded to the source. Provide `filename` in JSON request body (not as query parameter). JSON body limited to 1 MiB + 4 KiB including aspects. Request remains open during fetch/upload; allow >300 seconds for completion. Media processing may continue after response. If connection closes or times out, check library before retrying as an asset may already exist.

data.current_summary: Query media in the Media Library
data.current_description:
Use GROQ to query the Media Library.

Requests without a token are allowed, but return only data that is publicly readable. On a private library they return an empty result rather than an error.

See the [GROQ documentation](https://www.sanity.io/docs/groq) for more information on writing GROQ queries.
data.description_suggestion: Query media assets in the Media Library using GROQ syntax. data.current_summary: Upload an asset to the media library from a URL
data.current_description:
Fetches a public or preauthorized HTTPS URL through Sanity's bounded egress proxy, then processes the response with the ordinary Media Library upload pipeline. The source is limited to 50 MiB and the fetch may take up to 300 seconds. Caller credentials and headers are not forwarded to the source. Provide `filename` in the JSON request body; the `filename` query parameter used by `/upload` is not accepted here.

Follows up to three redirects. The source and each redirect destination must use HTTPS without embedded credentials and pass the source policy. The JSON request body is limited to 1 MiB plus 4 KiB, including aspects.

The request stays open while the asset is fetched and uploaded. Allow more than 300 seconds for the client request. Media processing can continue after the response. If the connection closes or the request times out, check the library before retrying: an asset or version may already have been created.
